📢 JOB OPPORTUNITY | GOA TOURISM DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION LTD.

Goa Tourism Development Corporation Limited (GTDC) invites applications for the post of Technical Assistant (Civil) on a contractual basis.

📍 Location: Panaji, Goa
🔹 No. of Vacancies: 03
🔹 Age Limit: Not exceeding 45 years
🔹 Contract Period: Initially 3 years
🔹 Pay Scale: ₹9,300–₹34,800 + Grade Pay ₹4,200

Educational Qualification & Requirements:
• Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognised university or equivalent
• Minimum 5 years of practical experience in civil engineering works
• Knowledge of AutoCAD and Konkani
• Knowledge of Marathi is desirable

📅 Last Date to Apply: 17 November 2026, by 5:00 PM

📄 Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format along with the required documents at the Project Cell, GTDC, 4th Floor, Paryatan Bhavan, Patto, Panaji, Goa.

🔗 For the application form, detailed eligibility criteria and instructions, visit:
www.goa-tourism.com and Government portal www.goa.gov.in 

⚠️ Candidates should carefully read the official guidelines before applying.
